definition: the line that runs trains for passengers
description: On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.
